new_rows.claim: **The full loopy-child partition at 3×3, exhaustive over 47,456 non-terminal parents (T419, 2026-08-08, instrument `src/t419_taxonomy.zig`; artifact `data/oracle-3x3-v2.wzo2`; all reconciliations with T412's published table EXACT).** T412's buckets reproduce exactly: forced 5,080 (one-of-one 4,420, all-loopy k≥2 660), partial 448, no-loop 41,928, optimal children 97,064 (6,672 loopy, 6.87%), tautology 0/47,456. Gap 1 split of no-loop: **(a) 9,480 positions have loopy children, none of them optimal — a loop is reachable but optimal play declines it — and (b) 32,448 have no loopy children at all; (a)+(b) = 41,928 EXACTLY.** Margin (best loopy child vs optimal value) for (a): n=9,480, median 9, mean 8.55, range 1..12 — the distribution is bimodal (large margins 6/9/12 dominate: 2,196/2,032/2,716; small margins 1-2 only 548) — optimal play decisively rejects reachable loops at most of these positions, but 548 decline them by just 1-2 points. Gap 2 depth (permissive/forced): depth-1 5,528/5,080 (= forced+partial, reconciled), depth-2 5,504/4,800, depth-3 5,408/3,656; monotone (perm1≥perm2≥perm3, forced1≥forced2≥forced3). **T416 reconciliation: depth-3 forced 3,656 ≥ 80 (T416's forced-cycle states, exhaustive) — PASS; the compelled-loop lower bound holds and runs 45× deeper than the forced-cycle floor.** Controls: force_loopy seeded reads 100% forced (47,456/47,456, matching T412's published control) with depth-1 100% (depth-2/3 < 100% only where an optimal line ends in a terminal leaf — the game genuinely cannot continue); none_loopy null reads all-zero (forced 0, no_loop 47,456 all in (b), depth 0). Scope: fresh-start table (C1); not a real-game PSK claim; ko-sensitive columns distrusted pending Track A. MEASUREMENT, not PROVEN.

**The full loopy-child partition at 4×4 on T412's declared reservoir sample (200,000 of 98,616,794 non-terminal parents, seed 42 — reproduced verbatim; all reconciliations with T412's published table EXACT) (T419, 2026-08-08, instrument `src/t419_taxonomy.zig`; artifact `data/oracle-4x4-v2.wzo2`).** T412's buckets reproduce exactly: forced 6,073 (one-of-one 5,487, all-loopy k≥2 586), partial 862, no-loop 193,065, optimal children 728,671 (7,793 loopy, 1.07%), tautology 0/200,000. Gap 1 split of no-loop: **(a) 23,459 positions have loopy children, none of them optimal — a loop is reachable but optimal play declines it — and (b) 169,606 have no loopy children at all; (a)+(b) = 193,065 EXACTLY.** Margin for (a): n=23,459, median 15, mean 13.94, range 1..26 — dominated by large margins (1,514 at margin 10, 914 at 11, 1,376+ at 12..15 per the histogram); small margins 1-2 only 1,173 — optimal play decisively rejects reachable loops at most positions. Gap 2 depth (permissive/forced): depth-1 6,935/6,073 (= forced+partial, reconciled), depth-2 6,722/5,612, depth-3 6,535/4,867; monotone both directions. **A SAMPLE — every count is a sample statistic, and the depth-3 forced 4,867 is a sample lower bound, not the exhaustive 4×4 answer (T416's forced-cycle status at 4×4 is still OPEN).** Controls: force_loopy seeded 100% forced at 3×3 (this instrument) plus T412's published 4×4 force_loopy control (50,000/50,000 forced, cited); none_loopy null all-zero at 3×3. Scope: fresh-start table (C1); ko-sensitive columns distrusted pending Track A (the 4×4 artifact is the writes-ON checkpoint per the AGENTS.md foreclosure). MEASUREMENT, not PROVEN.

notes: T419 (deepseek-v4-flash, 2026-08-08) closes the five-count gap the operator asked for: T412 answered two counts exactly (forced-loop, one-of-one), conflated two into the no-loop bucket, and never measured the fifth (the depth-2 question). Instrument src/t419_taxonomy.zig is additive (reads WZO2 only; no engine/artifact/axiom edits), test-first per the standing tooling rule: 17 unit tests written first (red against stubs, then green), wired into `zig build test` (build.zig); the wired artifact is absent from the suite's failed-command list and runs clean standalone — the suite's 15 failures are pre-existing on this host (vb_* battery crashes, regression scripts), not caused by this row. The 4×4 sample reproduces T412's verbatim (same reservoir algorithm, seed 42, entry order): every published bucket matches exactly, which is the regression check that the classifier did not change. Loopy criterion L<H kept verbatim from T412 so the numbers compose. Gap 1: no_loop_a + no_loop_b == no_loop at both sizes (9,480+32,448=41,928 at 3×3; 23,459+169,606=193,065 at 4×4) — exact, so the classifier did not change. Gap 2: depth-1 permissive == forced+partial at both sizes (5,528/6,935) and depth-1 forced == forced (5,080/6,073) — the depth machinery re-derives T412's sibling counts. T416 reconciliation: depth-3 forced 3,656 at 3×3 ≥ 80 (every T416 forced-cycle state satisfies the depth-3 forced condition — proven in the doc: a forced cycle cannot contain an L==H node, so every optimal child on it is loopy) — PASS. Also observed: depth-3 permissive 5,408 ≥ T416's 4,550 states-on-cycles, consistent with cycles lying in the loopy region. Margin distributions: no_loop_a parents decline reachable loops mostly by large margins (3×3 median 9, 4×4 median 15), with a small tail declining by 1-2 points (3×3: 548 of 9,480; 4×4: 1,173 of 23,459). Controls: force_loopy seeded RED at 3×3 reads 100% forced (47,456/47,456 — matches T412's published control) and depth-1 100%; depth-2/3 read < 100% only where an optimal line ends in a terminal leaf (the game genuinely cannot continue past a double-pass) — reported, not hidden. none_loopy null reads all-zero. The null control caught a real defect during development: the none_loopy flag was initially not wired into the classifier and the run showed real data; the null control exposed it and it was fixed before any reading was taken. 4×4 run peaked 1,627 MB RSS (under the 4 GB runner guard). Evidence: docs/evidence/T419-TAXONOMY/{3x3-real,4x4-real,3x3-forceloopy,3x3-noneloopy}.json. Direction: the operator's reassuring case (positions with loopy children that optimal play declines) is REAL and LARGE — 9,480/47,456 at 3×3, 23,459/200,000 at 4×4 — but the depth ladder shows the compelled case decays slowly: 5,080 → 4,800 → 3,656 at 3×3, i.e. at 3,656 positions every optimal move is loopy for three full plies (both players), a lower bound that still far exceeds T416's 80 forced-cycle states.
